problem:
For the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}x & 3 & y \\ 2 & x & z \\ 1 & w & 5\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{12}$ of the element ${a}_{12}.$

${M}_{12}=${{field-1}}
worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${a}_{12},$ we remove the first row and second column: 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 3 & ∗ \\ 2 & ∗ & z \\ 1 & ∗ & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${a}_{12}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{12} & =det[\begin{aligned}2 & z \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & z \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot 5-z\cdot 1 \\  & =10-z\end{aligned}
$$
